moments.title: Payments pass client approval rules in Access (approval…
moments.action: Payments pass client approval rules in Access (approval categories/rules with a configurable number of approvers; security token required for 'wire payment approval and release' and for Wire, US ACH Initiation, Global ACH, FX, Tax and Utility entitlements [S974]) and bank compliance/fraud review holds ('Pending Compliance Review', 'Pending Fraud Review' [S973]; sanctions BLOCKED [S972]).
moments.frontstage: Bank screening is visible as explicit payment states in J.P. Morgan developer documentation: track-and-trace internal statuses include 'Pending Compliance Review', 'Pending Fraud Review', 'Pending Credit Decision' and 'Pending Client Review' [S973]; Global Payments 2 wires show PROCESSING/PENDING_JPM_REVIEW – 'J.P. Morgan placed the payment on hold pending review' [S971]; callbacks report BLOCKED – 'The payment was blocked due to a sanctions issue' [S972]. Client-side multi-level approval wording not found in developer docs.

moments.title: Track via Access reporting and Payment Tracker ('Follow your payments…
moments.action: Track via Access reporting and Payment Tracker ('Follow your payments from initiation to completion with real-time status updates'; accessportal.jpmorgan.com/PaymentTracker); FX wires with real-time tracking; cross-currency settlement mostly same day, next day or two business days.

moments.title: Recall/investigation via Global Client Service
moments.frontstage: Developer docs expose cancellation outcomes but not a recall workflow: status 'Canceled' ('The payment was canceled'), gpi reason FOCR 'Return following a cancellation request', CUST 'Requested by customer' [S973]; callbacks report RETURNED 'The payment was returned to the debtor party' [S972]. Recall/investigation channel (Global Client Service) remains INFERRED.

status_tracking.where: J.P. Morgan Payments API status endpoints and callbacks (Global Payments / Global Payments 2; Payment Status Track and Trace with gpi); Access reporting / Payment Tracker

assessment: Inventory confirmed from jpmorgan.com navigation; operational detail not fetched in this cycle. Coverage note: jpmorgan.com Access, FedNow, Payments (payables), Receivables and Cross-Currency pages captured; Connect guides captured. Wire recall in Connect: Payment activity > All wire activity > 'Report a problem' > 'request a recall' (authorized users, up to 13 months); real-time payment return requests via 877-242-7372.
